description: Human source and processor: opening conceptual question

origin.prompt: Create one text-free editorial concept illustration for a vertical beginner programming explainer. Portrait 2:3 image, premium technical architectural editorial style. An upright warm-ivory sheet of source material on the left with only abstract tiny nonlinguistic blue line marks (no readable text, letters, digits), a small beautifully machined dark microprocessor on the right. Between them a flowing arc of translucent cyan, pale peach and warm yellow glass-like strips, suggesting translation from human-authored source to machine instructions. Physical ceramic paper, brushed aluminium, layered translucent acrylic, precise delicate blueprint construction lines on ivory background, soft sunrise side light and realistic gentle contact shadows. Material and atmosphere inspired by supplied pastel architectural wave reference, but make a new composition focused on the sheet and chip; not a wave copy. Elegant magazine illustration, not cartoon, no mascot, no logos, no watermark, no type, no UI, no arrows and no actual code. Concentrate subject in lower middle with generous clean ivory upper 28% for separate native headline; avoid busy ornament. Palette ivory #f4f4f0, sky #75bde0, peach #f8bc9b, yellow #f8d49b, charcoal #1a1a1a. This is a conceptual image, not a factual hardware diagram.
